name: ui-ux-product-design
description: Improve product flows, usability, information architecture, interaction patterns, and user-centered interface decisions.
---
# UI/UX product design
- Start from user goals, context, frequency of use, and critical tasks; map the current journey before redesigning.
- Reduce steps for frequent tasks while making destructive actions deliberate and reversible where practical.
- Establish clear navigation, consistent terminology, visible system status, helpful validation, and useful empty states.
- Use progressive disclosure for advanced settings; do not hide essential monitoring status.
- Make forms forgiving: preserve valid input, explain errors, and avoid ambiguous controls.
- Prototype key flows and check edge cases, mobile use, keyboard use, and cognitive load.
- Explain design tradeoffs and avoid claiming user research that was not performed.
